verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site states that cardholders "earn unlimited cashback automatically deposited into your account — no manual redemption or confusing points", which matches the story's no-redemption requirement directly. It also specifies a 1.5% cashback rate on credit card spend. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that cashback is deposited automatically, and no detailed docs on eligibility, deposit timing, or which cards qualify (credit only vs. debit).
